_doc: NALATI-MERGE A1: Nalati's sound families, rendered with MOSS-SoundEffect v2 (gen_sfx_moss.py --jobs sfx-nalati-jobs.json) and Stable Audio 3 Medium (gen_sfx.py --model medium --jobs sfx-nalati-jobs.json); sfx_nalati.py ranks both with CLAP and merges the better take per family INTO public/assets/sfx/best/ (the one set). `group`: siblings that are not each other's CLAP competitors (a hoof on grass vs on gravel). Every entry ships tagged shard 'nalati' in sfx.json, so only the steppe decodes it.

wolf_howl.desc: a lone wolf howling at night
wolf_howl.prompt: A single grey wolf howling: a long rising, holding and falling howl in the open steppe at night, a second wolf joining far off. Natural field recording, no music.

wolf_snarl.desc: a wolf snarling and growling through bared teeth
wolf_snarl.prompt: A wolf snarling and growling aggressively through bared teeth, close, a rattling throaty growl. No music.

wolf_bite.desc: a wolf's jaws snapping shut in a bite
wolf_bite.prompt: A wolf lunging and biting: jaws snapping shut with a hard click and a short vicious growl, close. No music.

wolf_yip.prompt: A young wolf giving three short excited high yips and barks, close, outdoors. No music.

wolf_yelp.prompt: A wolf yelping in pain after being hit: a sharp high cry sliding down into a whimper. No music.

horse_neigh.prompt: A horse neighing loudly: a high quavering whinny falling in steps, ending in a soft nicker, outdoors on open grassland. No music.

horse_snort.desc: a horse snorting through its nostrils
horse_snort.prompt: A horse snorting: a blast of air through flapping nostrils, a short blow, close. No music.

horse_squeal.prompt: An angry stallion squealing shrilly, a short aggressive shriek as it kicks, close. No music.

dog_bark.prompt: A large shepherd dog barking two or three deep chesty barks outdoors in a field. No music.

dog_yelp.prompt: A dog yelping sharply in pain, one high cry and a short whimper. No music.

sheep_bleat.prompt: A single sheep bleating baa with a wobbling nasal voice, close, outdoors in a meadow. No music.

marmot_whistle.prompt: An alpine marmot's alarm call: one or two piercing high sharp whistles echoing across a mountain meadow. No music.

eagle_cry.desc: a golden eagle screeching high in the sky
eagle_cry.prompt: A golden eagle calling high overhead: a thin piercing screech kee-yeer, twice, over open mountains. No music.

leopard_growl.desc: a snow leopard hissing and growling
leopard_growl.prompt: A snow leopard growling and hissing: a rasping, sawing big-cat growl with a spit of breath, close. No music.

king_call.desc: an undead warrior king groaning inside a stone tomb
king_call.prompt: A huge undead warrior king in a stone burial mound: a deep hollow echoing groan and a rattle of gold armour, reverberant tomb, no words. No music.

king_hurt.desc: an armoured giant roaring in pain
king_hurt.prompt: A giant armoured undead king struck by a blade: a short deep roar of pain with metal armour clanking, echoing stone chamber, no words. No music.

hoof-grass.prompt: One horse trotting two steps on soft grass turf: muffled low hoof thuds with a swish of grass, close. No music.

hoof-gravel.prompt: One horse trotting two steps on loose gravel and river stones: a crunching clatter of hooves, close. No music.

hoof-wood.desc: horse hooves on a wooden bridge
hoof-wood.prompt: One horse trotting two steps across a wooden plank bridge: hollow knocking hoof clops on the boards, close. No music.

stampede.desc: a herd of wild horses stampeding past
stampede.prompt: A herd of wild horses stampeding past across a grassy plain: a thundering rumble of many galloping hooves shaking the ground, building and passing. No music.

footstep-grass.desc: a single footstep on tall dry grass
footstep-grass.prompt: A single footstep of a leather boot on tall dry steppe grass, a soft crush and swish, close. No music.

footstep-gravel.prompt: A single footstep of a leather boot on a gravel road, a small crunch of stones, close. No music.

bowDraw.desc: a wooden bow being drawn with a creak
bowDraw.prompt: An archer slowly drawing a horn and wood recurve bow: the string stretching and the limbs creaking under tension, close. No music.

bowFullDraw.desc: a small click and creak of a bow held at full draw
bowFullDraw.prompt: A bow held at full draw: one small tight creak of wood and a soft click of the arrow nock, close, quiet. No music.

bowLetDown.desc: a bow string eased back without shooting
bowLetDown.prompt: An archer easing a drawn bow back down without shooting: the string relaxing with a soft creak and a faint rattle of the arrow, close. No music.

bowTwang.desc: a bow string twanging as an arrow is shot
bowTwang.prompt: A recurve bow shooting an arrow: the string releases with a deep twang and a thump of the limbs, close. No music.

arrowWhoosh.desc: an arrow whooshing past through the air
arrowWhoosh.prompt: An arrow flying fast past the listener: a short sharp whoosh of air. No music.

arrowImpact-wood.desc: an arrow thudding into wood and quivering
arrowImpact-wood.prompt: An arrow striking a wooden post: a hard thunk and the shaft quivering, close. No music.

arrowImpact-ground.desc: an arrow sticking into the ground
arrowImpact-ground.prompt: An arrow sticking into soft earth and turf: a dull short thud. No music.

arrowImpact-flesh.desc: an arrow hitting an animal's body
arrowImpact-flesh.prompt: An arrow hitting an animal's body: a short wet thud, close. No music.

sabreSwing.desc: a curved steel sabre swishing through the air
sabreSwing.prompt: A curved steel cavalry sabre swung fast: a thin sharp swish through the air with a faint ring of the blade, close. No music.

sabreHit-flesh.prompt: A steel sabre slashing into a body: a sharp cutting slash with a wet thud, close. No music.

sabreHit-wood.desc: a sabre chopping into wood with a ringing blade
sabreHit-wood.prompt: A steel sabre chopping into wood: a hard chop with the blade ringing afterwards, close. No music.

spearThrust.prompt: A spear thrust hard forward: a short fast rip of air and the wooden shaft creaking, close. No music.

javelinThrow.desc: a javelin thrown with a heavy whoosh
javelinThrow.prompt: A heavy javelin thrown hard: a grunt of effort and a long heavy whoosh of the spear flying away. No music.

javelinImpact-wood.prompt: A heavy javelin slamming into a wooden post: a deep thunk and the long shaft ringing, close. No music.

javelinImpact-ground.desc: a javelin stabbing into the earth
javelinImpact-ground.prompt: A heavy javelin stabbing deep into the earth: a deep thud and a spray of dirt. No music.

javelinImpact-flesh.prompt: A heavy javelin hitting a large animal's body: a deep wet thud, close. No music.

thunder-near.prompt: A lightning strike very close: an ear-splitting thunder crack tearing overhead, then a long heavy rolling rumble, open plain. No music.

thunder-far.prompt: Distant thunder: a low soft rolling rumble far away over the mountains, no crack. No music.

lightningCrackle.desc: static electricity crackling before a lightning strike
lightningCrackle.prompt: Crackling static electricity building in the air just before a lightning strike: dry rapid snaps and sizzles rising in intensity. No music.

bed-steppe-wind.desc: wind blowing through tall grass on an open steppe
bed-steppe-wind.prompt: Ambience of an open grassy steppe by day: a steady wind hissing through tall dry grass, soft gusts swelling and fading, no birds, no voices. Continuous field recording, no music.

bed-steppe-larks.desc: skylarks singing high above a meadow
bed-steppe-larks.prompt: Ambience of skylarks singing high above a summer meadow: long tumbling bright trills from several birds far overhead, a faint breeze. Continuous field recording, no music.

bed-steppe-night.desc: crickets chirping in grassland at night
bed-steppe-night.prompt: Ambience of a grassland at night: many crickets chirping steadily, a very light cool breeze in the grass, calm and still. Continuous field recording, no music.

bed-river.desc: a fast mountain river rushing over stones
bed-river.prompt: Ambience beside a fast clear mountain river: water rushing and splashing over gravel and stones, steady and continuous. Field recording, no music.

bed-meltwater.desc: meltwater trickling and dripping from a glacier
bed-meltwater.prompt: Ambience at the foot of a glacier: meltwater trickling and gurgling in small icy streams, drips of water, a cold faint wind. Continuous field recording, no music.

bed-camp.desc: a crackling wood fire with tent fabric flapping in the wind
bed-camp.prompt: Ambience of a nomad camp: a wood fire crackling and popping close by, heavy felt and canvas tent flaps rustling and flapping in a steady wind, open grassland all around. Continuous field recording, no music, no voices.
bed-camp.reroll: round 1 (a stove, felt flaps, a distant goat and camp life) ranked 7 (MOSS) / 10 (SA3): CLAP heard a stampede; re-rolled with a plainer prompt

bed-highwind.desc: strong wind across a high open plateau
bed-highwind.prompt: Ambience on a high open mountain plateau: a strong steady wind blowing across wide grassland, deep whooshing gusts, far away a herd of horses. Continuous field recording, no music.

bed-coldwind.desc: a cold howling wind in snowy mountains
bed-coldwind.prompt: Ambience of a snowy mountain valley: a cold thin howling wind whistling over snow and rock, lonely and icy. Continuous field recording, no music.

bed-rain.prompt: Ambience of heavy rain falling on open grassland: a dense steady patter and hiss of raindrops on grass and earth, no thunder. Continuous field recording, no music.

bed-stormwind.prompt: Ambience of a violent storm wind: a deep roaring gale blasting across an open plain, surging and howling, no rain, no thunder. Continuous field recording, no music.
